text: The Human-Derived Coordination Architecture implements only the consumption side of the computative labor market: job specifications, expertise taxonomies, and contract templates are exogenous parameters set by clients or governance, so the generation side is absent from the protocol.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Possibility Loops An Operational Architecture for Computative Economics in Agent Coordination Systems (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=6655138

isBasedOn.name: Possibility Loops An Operational Architecture for Computative Economics in Agent Coordination Systems

abstract: HDCA implements the consumption side of the computative labor market and does not implement the generation side. Job specifications, expertise taxonomies, and contract templates are exogenous parameters set by clients or by governance.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: current agent coordination protocols inherited from human freelance markets
